sophia (Docs): quick thread 14dd - i'm finishing the Optimize toolkit migration doc and spotted a few live issues in the PR snippets: the JS batch example uses the old single-call pattern and the python prefetch sample is absent. also the quant table wording is a bit too prescriptive. can we quick-check before i merge?
den (DevEx): paste the two snippets and the quant text you plan to ship. i'll run the smoke tests in samples.
sophia (Docs): JS that landed in PR: 
```js
// current (bad) example in PR
const resp = await client.batch.create({ input: prompt, max_tokens: 256 })
console.log(resp.output)
```
python intended prefetch (missing):
```py
# missing prefetch guidance in PR
resp = client.generate(model="redwood/fast-ggml", prompt=prompt, max_tokens=256)
```
and the quant table cell reads: "q8_0: recommended for cost-sensitive workloads" which is fine but reads like an unconditional recommendation.
hugo (Runtime): runtime/API changes: batch.create was removed in SDK v2. use client.batch.request({inputs: [...], max_tokens}) or client.stream.open for streaming. also add a KV prefetch example for short repeated prefixes: `client.cache.prefetch([prefix], mode="kv")` to avoid recomputing keys every request.
maya (ML): agree on toning down the quant language: suggest: "q8_0: lower memory & cost; evaluate on a 100-sample generation set and a 1k-sample embedding set before adopting." also note q4_0 tends to retain generation fidelity better on instruction-following prompts.
den (DevEx): here's a minimal replacement i'm testing now: 
```js
// replacement JS
const resp = await client.batch.request({ inputs: [prompt], max_tokens: 256 })
console.log(resp[0].text)
```
```py
# python prefetch example to add
client.cache.prefetch(["session_v1"], mode="kv")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood/fast-ggml", prompt=prompt, max_tokens=256)
```
link-checker-bot: docs-link-check: found broken link in PR #824 -> /docs/sdk/js/batch.create (404) :warning:
sophia (Docs): thanks den/hugo/maya. i'll update the quant table wording to your phrasing and add both snippets. i'll also add a migration checklist item: "replace batch.create -> client.batch.request or client.stream.open; add cache.prefetch where prefix reuse occurs."
hugo (Runtime): small callout request: add a note about batching for short sequences (set max_batch_latency_ms: 10-30ms or prefer per-route low-latency policy) so people don't accidentally increase p99. also mention that prefetching with many unique prefixes can increase memory — good to warn.
den (DevEx): tests green locally with the replacements. opened tiny PR #825 with snippet fixes + link correction.
sophia (Docs): perfect, will merge after CI. adding changelog line "Optimize: clarify quant guidance; fix JS/Python snippets; add KV prefetch migration note." closing once merged. :tada:
